feed.title: The Hour Brief
feed.subtitle: A free daily one-hour digest of AI & tech, product & business (India + global), and the Indian stock market.

entry.title: Edition 019 — 3 September 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: OpenAI's Astra becomes the first model to cross a "Critical" cybersecurity threshold after autonomously finding zero-day exploits, as Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 claims to beat GPT-5.6 Sol at coding and Google ships Gemini 3.8 Flash alongside a locked-down Cyber variant, while enterprise "AI operating system" startup Wonderful doubles its valuation to $5 billion in six months and physical-AI perception startup Lyte triples to $1.6 billion. Product & Business: India's InsuranceDekho and RenewBuy merge into the country's largest AI-led insurance platform ahead of a DRHP by month's end, as Zepto pauses its IPO for a ₹1,000 crore pre-IPO round and the NSE eyes a roughly ₹5.2 lakh crore listing on the BSE, while JioHotstar takes its streaming platform global and Byju Raveendran offers up Aakash shares to settle a $235 million Qatar Holding claim. Stock Market: Sensex and Nifty extend their slide to a third straight session as fresh US strikes on Iran send Brent crude near $95 and the 10-year Treasury yield to its highest since November 2023, even as Coal India rallies on Mahanadi Coalfields IPO buzz and Adani Ports gains on record August cargo volumes.

entry.title: Edition 018 — 2 September 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: The Pentagon's custom ChatGPT and Grok rollout tops 1.7 million users and Anthropic locks in a $35 billion Nvidia-backed compute deal with Lambda, as the FTC and 22 states sue Amazon over an alleged $20 billion advertiser overcharge scheme, while Berlin confirms Rhysida ransomware stole city data weeks before its state election, the EU commits €387.8 million to an AMD-powered supercomputer in Finland, and Meta's $18 billion child-safety settlement leans on AI to guess who's underage. Product & Business: India's Unacademy completes its edtech unwind, selling to rival upGrad for $200 million — a 94% haircut from its $3.4 billion peak — as Vodafone Idea recruits Shah Rukh Khan for a rebrand push and Amazon Now plots a 300-city quick-commerce expansion, while Tata Elxsi partners with Sarla Aviation on India's first indigenous air taxi, and fresh funding lands for battery-swapping network Yuma Energy and EV-charger maker Zenergize. Stock Market: Adani group stocks rebound up to 4.6% a day after MSCI's rebalancing collided with India's new closing auction to wipe $15 billion off the group, as ITC jumps on an AI-services push into Happiest Minds and Hy-Tech Engineers' IPO surges 48% on debut, even as fresh US strikes on Iran send oil and Treasury yields higher and Wall Street falls for a second straight session on surging Fed rate-hike odds.

entry.title: Edition 017 — 1 September 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Anthropic reportedly preps an IPO that could match SpaceX's record $86.2 billion raise as OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman bankrolls a $50 million campaign defending AI data centers ahead of the midterms, while infostealer malware is caught hijacking Claude accounts without a password, OpenAI quietly buys up tens of thousands of Mac minis to train its next computer-using agents, and Brussels designates ChatGPT a regulated "search engine" under its toughest digital-safety rules. Product & Business: HDFC Bank stuns investors as CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan declines a fresh term and will exit on October 26, just as Apple's John Ternus formally succeeds Tim Cook as CEO and Nvidia commits $3.5 billion to MediaTek to lock down a custom-AI-chip ally, while Aon agrees to pay KKR $17 billion for USI Insurance, State Street closes its stake in Groww's asset-management arm, and Purple Style Labs' ₹680 crore IPO draws a tepid opening day. Stock Market: MSCI's index rejig collides with India's new closing-auction mechanism to wipe roughly $15 billion off Adani Group stocks, dragging Sensex and Nifty into a second straight loss as fresh US-Iran clashes send Brent crude above $90, even as gold-fintech Augmont Enterprises pops 22% on debut and Wall Street closes out a winning August on a cautious note.

entry.title: Edition 016 — 31 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic and name founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann personally as defendants, as underwriters reportedly float a $2 trillion IPO valuation for the AI company, while Waymo publicly rejects Tesla's camera-only self-driving approach, OpenAI switches on ChatGPT ads across 31 European markets, and Apple readies a $1,999 foldable iPhone for a September 9 unveiling. Product & Business: India's NCLT weighs today whether Byju's insolvency bidding can resume as Swiggy agrees to refund Bengaluru restaurants after a boycott threat, while ESDS Software's ₹720 crore IPO draws strong retail demand, Avaada Electro files for a ₹7,600 crore solar-manufacturing IPO, and IIT Bombay-incubated InspeCity raises ₹100 crore to refuel satellites in orbit. Stock Market: MSCI's India rebalance readies roughly $2.3 billion in passive inflows for Laurus Labs, Lenskart and Adani Energy Solutions as Sensex and Nifty snap a two-day slide on an IT-led rally, even as Asian markets slide into Monday on Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish tone and crude above $91, and Purple Style Labs opens its ₹680 crore IPO for bidding.

entry.title: Edition 015 — 30 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Over 100 companies including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google warn AI-powered cyberattacks are "no longer a distant risk" as critics call Sam Altman's response tone-deaf given OpenAI's own models have hacked its own systems, while Anthropic gives Claude a built-in browser, Generalist AI hits a $3 billion valuation, and Meta reportedly preps a $199-a-month AI agent platform. Product & Business: HDFC Bank's CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan steps back after steering its HDFC merger as OpenAI cuts off Cursor's model access following SpaceX's $60 billion Anysphere buyout, while Hero MotoCorp deepens its Ather Energy stake ahead of Ather's sub-₹1-lakh scooter launch, and Indian startups pull in $210 million this week led by Third Wave Coffee. Stock Market: Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole tone sends September rate-hike odds surging and Treasury yields higher, dragging Bitcoin toward $78,000 and gold off its highs over the weekend, even as Purple Style Labs' muted grey-market premium hints at a calmer IPO debut ahead of Monday's opening.

entry.title: Edition 014 — 29 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: A federal judge rules the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic unlawful as Nvidia quietly pauses its AI Compute Partnership cloud-financing deals over antitrust worries, while Marvell's stock slides despite record revenue on a delayed Google chip payoff and Meta closes another loophole in its smart glasses' recording light. Product & Business: Mukesh Ambani's Jio Platforms gets SEBI's nod for what could be India's biggest-ever IPO as Tata Motors unifies its lineup under a new TATA.CARS identity, while Bengaluru's InstaAstro and Micromax's new deeptech family office keep funding flowing, Bengaluru hoteliers defer their Swiggy-Zomato boycott, and Gap's stock jumps on an Old Navy leadership shake-up. Stock Market: Nifty IT stocks surge as much as 5% on Nvidia's spillover optimism even as Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech warns inflation is still too high, Tempsens Instruments becomes 2026's biggest IPO debut gainer, and SEBI's crackdown on alleged Sensex closing-auction manipulation keeps market-structure worries alive into the weekend.

entry.title: Edition 013 — 28 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Nvidia reportedly agrees to pay $12.9 billion for Hugging Face and Salesforce's stock jumps 22% on a new Claude-powered CRM tie-up, as Reuters reveals Zuckerberg's plan to replace up to 60% of Meta's staff with AI has quietly collapsed and Russian hackers are caught weaponizing Cursor's AI coding agent to speed up ransomware breaches. Product & Business: OpenAI brings ads to ChatGPT in India as Deepinder Goyal's Temple buys a London longevity clinic and Bengaluru's Airbound raises $37 million for autonomous cargo drones, while DealShare nears a rescue acquisition, Ribbit Capital trims its Groww stake, and fresh funding spans Indian space-tech, impact investing and AI-agent startups. Stock Market: Nvidia's blowout guidance sends the Nasdaq to a fresh high even as a freak 20-minute flash crash rattles the BSE's new closing auction and Sensex, Nifty extend their slide into a second day, the rupee slips to 95.55 on dollar strength ahead of Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole debut, and Tempsens Instruments' IPO draws a 184x subscription.

entry.title: Edition 012 — 27 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Nvidia beats and raises but its stock whipsaws on margin worries as OpenAI's Jalapeño chip claims an edge over Nvidia's own Blackwell, Anthropic commits $45 billion to Nscale for compute, and Amazon shutters Mechanical Turk after 21 years while SpaceX unveils a $100 billion Starship complex in Louisiana. Product & Business: Meta agrees to pay up to $16.68 billion to settle a multistate child-safety lawsuit as India's Infra.Market plots a ₹10,545 crore reverse merger into Shalimar Paints and Honasa calls off its Fluence Pharma buyout, while Flipkart Minutes overtakes Swiggy Instamart in dark-store count and voice-AI startup Ringg, temple-services platform Utsav and EV motorcycle maker MATTER all raise fresh funding. Stock Market: Nvidia's beat-and-raise quarter fails to spark an immediate rally as margin worries creep in, Sensex and Nifty snap their two-day gains on a weak IT and FMCG day, crude extends its slide on Hormuz reopening hopes, and Symbiotec Pharmalab's ₹1,757 crore IPO draws strong demand ahead of Thursday's close.

entry.title: Edition 011 — 26 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: OpenAI dismantles a Russian ChatGPT propaganda network and Taiwan indicts nine people, including Nvidia and Super Micro staff, over a chip-smuggling scheme to China, as the SEC subpoenas four Wall Street banks over an AI hedge fund's near-collapse and Apple redesigns its cheapest Mac around on-device AI ahead of Nvidia's make-or-break earnings. Product & Business: Tata Consultancy Services strikes a $1.5 billion AI pact with Porsche while Germany's Infineon acquires Bengaluru chip startup C2i Semiconductors, as Karnataka suspends the food licences of Amazon, Swiggy Instamart and BigBasket over toxic Datura listings and a fresh run of IPO paper — from Purple Style Labs' ₹680 crore RHP to Shankesh Jewellers' strong debut — keeps India's primary markets busy. Stock Market: Oil tumbles 4% as markets shrug off Washington's toughest-yet Iran sanctions and chip stocks rally into Nvidia's still-unreported, market-defining earnings, while healthcare and PSU banking stocks lift the Sensex and Nifty off a weak open even as Federal Bank sinks on Jana Small Finance Bank buyout jitters.

entry.title: Edition 010 — 25 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Hugging Face explores a sale that could value it near $13 billion and Nvidia weighs a stake in Perplexity above $30 billion, as the AI industry's memory crunch forces Amazon to quietly raise prices on Echo, Kindle and Fire TV, and the SEC opens a probe into a hedge fund that nearly imploded betting big on AI stocks. Product & Business: India's capital markets have their best month on record as a $10 billion deal rush led by the LIC share sale rolls on, even as fresh funding for NeoGeoInfo, CtrlS and voice-AI startup Wispr Flow keeps AI and data-centre infrastructure the hottest category in tech, and Flipkart's senior ranks thin out over an unresolved IPO timeline. Stock Market: Fresh US sanctions on Iran jolt oil and the rupee, chip stocks slide ahead of Nvidia's make-or-break earnings, and metal stocks shield the Sensex and Nifty from a deeper Monday slide.

entry.title: Edition 009 — 24 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Anthropic's IPO prospectus will name public backlash against AI and data centers as a formal risk factor as Nvidia warns its biggest customers of AI server price hikes above 15% on soaring memory costs, while Hugging Face explores a sale that could value the open-model hub at $13 billion or more. Product & Business: Sachin Bansal's Navi raises its first-ever institutional capital — a $100 million Prosus round at a $1.3 billion valuation — as Nvidia pays $6 billion to license AI coding startup Poolside's model-building software and hire over 100 of its staff, while Battery Smart, Cashfree Payments and a Nobel Hygiene IPO filing round out a busy week for Indian fintech, EV infrastructure and hygiene-products manufacturing. Stock Market: US Treasury yields hold near 20-month highs as markets brace for Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole address as Fed chair, Brent crude holds near $94 a barrel on an unresolved US-Iran standoff, and Bitcoin claws back above $78,000 as a broader crypto rally resumes after Saturday's flash crash.

entry.title: Edition 008 — 23 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Anthropic's IPO prospectus will flag "AI backlash" as a formal risk factor as Broadcom lines up $100 billion in debt to bankroll Anthropic and OpenAI's chip buildout, while Tesla recalls nearly 3 million vehicles in China. Product & Business: Tiger Global-backed Upstox begins talks for a $400 million IPO as Indian startup funding jumps 94% in a week, while Amazon, Uber, DoorDash and Walmart race into the skies with drone delivery and India's own drone-infrastructure bets deepen. Stock Market: Markets are closed for the weekend after Friday's near-flat finish, as US Treasury yields hit 20-month highs, Bitcoin's best week since 2024 ends in a Saturday flash crash, and Tempsens Instruments' IPO draws a 21x subscription.

entry.title: Edition 007 — 22 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Nvidia pays $6 billion to license AI coding startup Poolside as Broadcom seeks up to $80 billion to bankroll Anthropic's chip buildout, while a perfect-10 Entra ID flaw already under attack forces Microsoft into emergency mode. Product & Business: Sachin Bansal's Navi takes its first outside money and Stripe pays $8 billion for OpenRouter, as New York overtakes Silicon Valley in tech jobs and Zepto, Atomberg, Augmont and Temple all queue up for India's IPO market. Stock Market: Dalal Street ends flat after a whipsaw week as Bitcoin's 22% weekly surge outshines equities, even as Brent crude tops $94 on Trump's looming "economic D-Day" against Iran.

entry.title: Edition 006 — 21 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Google's $12B chip bet on Marvell and Cerebras' inference-first machine reshape AI's hardware map, as US agencies warn hackers are now using AI-generated exploits to target the power and water grid. Product & Business: Apple settles its App Store fight with Brussels and Starlink makes another run at India's skies, as fresh funding rounds span babycare, coffee and paediatric care. Stock Market: Dalal Street snaps a seven-day losing streak as Nifty and Sensex rebound on cooling Treasury yields, even as Wall Street slides on a 9% Walmart plunge and Trump's fresh threats send crude toward $94.

entry.title: Edition 005 — 20 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: AI's growth story turns physical and political — a robot maker's blockbuster IPO, a reusable rocket landing, chip diplomacy with China, and a US state moving to regulate the data centers powering it all. Product & Business: Razorpay builds its own AI foundation model for payments and KKR backs BookMyShow's live-events arm, as Stripe's $7B OpenRouter buy marks a new phase of global AI-infrastructure consolidation. Stock Market: Dalal Street's losing streak stretches to a seventh session as crude nears $92 and global bond yields stay elevated, even as Wall Street rallies on a Treasury debt-buyback surprise and Shiprocket's 35% IPO pop offers a bright spot at home.

entry.title: Edition 004 — 19 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Anthropic overtakes OpenAI on revenue as AI funding surges and safety scrutiny intensifies. Product & Business: Shiprocket lists as India's startup funding spans fintech to health-tech, and Silicon Valley faces its own reckonings. Stock Market: Record bond yields hit AI chip stocks and extend Sensex's slide, even as IPOs and Q1 earnings impress.

entry.title: Edition 003 — 18 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Stripe, Nvidia and Anthropic all place multi-billion-dollar bets on AI's next layer. Product & Business: India's startups swap growth-at-all-costs for profits, paid-down debt and market share. Stock Market: Oil, bond yields and a weaker rupee weigh on Dalal Street as AI chip demand bucks the trend.

entry.title: Edition 002 — 17 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: New models arrive as AI's talent and security cracks show. Product & Business: IPO season peaks as Molbio and Shiprocket hit the tape. Stock Market: FPIs turn buyers as oil and Nvidia's earnings loom over markets.

entry.title: Edition 001 — 16 August 2026
entry.summary: AI & Tech: Nvidia's $500B bet meets an AI price war. Product & Business: Everyone's doubling down — on data centers and DRHPs. Stock Market: AI rally lifts Wall Street, Middle East risk weighs on Dalal Street.
